title: World Engine
description: Configuration for the ADOS World Engine extension. Keys are flat and dotted: atlas.* is read on a drone (world-model capture), offload.* on a drone (perception offload), serving.* on a workstation or compute node (offload serving), and relay.* on a ground station (radio relay of the capture stream).

atlas.enabled.title: World-model capture
atlas.enabled.description: Capture pose-tagged keyframes on this drone and stream them to a compute node.

atlas.capture_profile.title: Capture profile
atlas.capture_profile.description: The flight pattern the keyframe selection is tuned for.

atlas.pose_tier.title: Pose source
atlas.pose_tier.description: auto resolves to the flight-controller pose; local forces the flight-controller pose; offload uses the compute node's SLAM pose; hybrid takes whichever arrived most recently.

atlas.reconstruct_steps.title: Reconstruction detail
atlas.reconstruct_steps.description: Default splat training steps used when a reconstruction is submitted.

atlas.hfov_deg.title: Horizontal field of view (degrees)
atlas.hfov_deg.description: Used to derive a pinhole model for a camera with no calibrated intrinsics.

atlas.cameras.title: Cameras
atlas.cameras.description: The capture rig, one camera up to an all-sides set, by vision-engine camera id. Capture stays idle until at least one camera is enabled.

atlas.live_reconstruct.title: Live reconstruction
atlas.live_reconstruct.description: On a compute node, rebuild the world model incrementally while keyframes arrive instead of only after the capture session is bagged.

atlas.pose_prior.title: Pose uncertainty
atlas.pose_prior.description: The pose prior each keyframe carries into the reconstruction. Set position_sigma_m outright for an RTK rig; otherwise it is the reported DOP times gnss_uere_m.

clock_offset_sigma_ns.description: One-sigma uncertainty of the node clock in ns; negative means unmeasured.

atlas.pose_max_age_ms.title: Pose age budget (ms)
atlas.pose_max_age_ms.description: A frame is only keyframed with a pose younger than this.

atlas.pose_publish_interval_ms.title: Pose publish interval (ms)
atlas.pose_publish_interval_ms.description: Minimum interval between published world poses.

atlas.selection.min_translation_m.title: Keyframe distance (m)
atlas.selection.min_translation_m.description: Minimum travel between keyframes of one camera.

atlas.selection.min_rotation_rad.title: Keyframe rotation (rad)
atlas.selection.min_rotation_rad.description: Minimum rotation between keyframes of one camera (0.26 rad is about 15 degrees).

atlas.selection.max_interval_ms.title: Keyframe interval (ms)
atlas.selection.max_interval_ms.description: A keyframe is taken at least this often while moving slowly.

atlas.selection.max_keyframes.title: Keyframe cap
atlas.selection.max_keyframes.description: Session-wide cap on selected keyframes; 0 is unlimited.

atlas.intrinsics.title: Calibrated intrinsics
atlas.intrinsics.description: Per-camera calibrated pinhole, keyed by camera id. A camera absent here uses a pinhole derived from the frame size and the field of view.

offload.enabled.title: Perception offload
offload.enabled.description: auto offloads detection when the drone has no accelerator and a compute node is reachable on the LAN; on forces offload; off never offloads.

offload.compute_node_addr.title: Compute node address
offload.compute_node_addr.description: Pin a compute node as host:port. Empty discovers one on the LAN.

serving.enabled.title: Serve perception offload
serving.enabled.description: auto accepts and serves LAN offload sessions; on forces serving; off never serves.

serving.detector_model.title: Served detector model
serving.detector_model.description: Model id of the detector served to drones. Empty uses the node's default.

relay.enabled.title: Relay the capture stream
relay.enabled.description: On a ground station, re-emit capture events received over the radio link onto the LAN for the compute node.

relay.compute_base_url.title: Compute node URL
relay.compute_base_url.description: The compute node the relay re-posts to (http://host:8092). Empty discovers one on the LAN.
